inputs.prompt: Reimagine this as an upscale restaurant marketing photograph. Softly blurred warm dark restaurant backdrop with ambient bokeh lighting, shallow depth of field, dramatic side lighting, high-end editorial food photography, 85mm lens. Remove all background clutter, utensils, and counter surfaces. Replate the grilled chicken nachos onto an elegant modern white platter with deliberate arrangement: tortilla chips fanned, grilled chicken and queso distributed evenly, with distinct tidy mounds of guacamole, black beans, pico de gallo, and pickled jalapenos. Keep every topping recognizable and fresh-looking.
